name: czgame_frame_on_size
description: CZGameFrame::OnSize forwards to the MFC frame handler and updates the cached video client rect when requested.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x443a20 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
CFrameWnd::OnSize is treated as an MFC42 provider call.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x443a20 validates CFrameWnd::OnSize(self, nType, cx, cy) followed by zVid::UpdateCachedClientRectIfUpdateMaskEnabled().
The native smoke patches the MFC provider OnSize call, invokes CZGameFrame::OnSize with a real HWND, and verifies the cached video client rect is refreshed when the update mask is enabled.
